about: Vendored original experimental/pharmacokinetic reference corpus for the DrugOS validation benchmark suite (validation/benchmarks). These are the published measured PK parameter bands the pipeline is checked against; they are the single source of truth for those pass bands and are loaded by validation/benchmarks/base.py (never duplicated inline in compound modules). Each entry cites its primary sources in validation/benchmarks/citations.py.

midazolam.about: Hepatic CYP3A4-extracted benzodiazepine; clearance axis validated.

acetaminophen.about: Low-binding analgesic; oral ACAT-lite absorption; metabolic clearance (hepatic 95%).

dofetilide.about: hERG-active Class III anti-arrhythmic; ~80% renal elimination.
